cohort: 200 pregnant women with first trimester vaginal bleeding in the first trimester of their pregnancy, aged 25-35 years, at a hospital in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India.
finding: First trimester vaginal bleeding can be a predictor of adverse maternal and infant outcomes, and closer monitoring and clinical intervention are necessary for these high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery occurred in 30% of participants, while cesarean section occurred in 35% of participants.
